== Airlines and destinations ==
Tianfu International Airport is a major base for [[Air China]]. The flag carrier operates maintenance facilities, a 1,500-bed staff hostel, and a {{Convert|2950|m2|ft2|abbr=on}} lounge at the airport. Due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], the airport did not operate international flights until 26 March 2023, taking over most international and cargo routes from Shuangliu International Airport, with the latter specializing in domestic flights. Beginning on 28 March 2023, Air China will change the flight to Taipei Taoyuan from Chengdu Shuangliu to Chengdu Tianfu.

Effective from 30 July 2026, some flights from these airlines will be transferred in batches from Terminal 1 of Tianfu Airport to Terminal 1 of [[Shuangliu Airport]]:
* 30 July 2026
- [[Air China]]: Chengdu and [[Taoyuan Airport|Taipei-Taoyuan]] <br>
- [[Hong Kong Airlines]]: Chengdu and [[Hong Kong International Airport|Hong Kong]] <br>
- [[Cathay Pacific]]: [[Hong Kong International Airport|Hong Kong]] and Chengdu <br>
- [[Air Macau]]: Chengdu and [[Macau Airport|Macau]]

* 31 July 2026
- [[Air China]]: Chengdu and Hong Kong <br>
- [[Sichuan Airlines]]: Chengdu and  Hong Kong, Chengdu and Taipei-Taoyuan<br>
- [[Cathay Pacific]]: Chengdu and Hong Kong<br>
- [[EVA Air]]: Chengdu and Taipei-Taoyuan

* 1 August 2026
- [[China Airlines]]: Chengdu and Taipei-Taoyuan
